bullets.text: The State government ordered civic agencies to complete flood mitigation work in Chennai and suburbs by October 15.
Residents in Vadaperumbakkam near Senthil Nagar staged a midnight road blockade protesting power cuts, clashing with police.
Residents in Adambakkam face disappointment as trains still do not stop at the station over seven months after the line opened.
Bill Gates warned that artificial intelligence poses a risk of causing up to one billion deaths globally.
TANGEDCO announced a five-hour power shutdown across several regions in Chennai on Wednesday, September 30.
Drinking water supply was restored in Adyar and Perungudi zones after the completion of major pipeline relocation work.
The Greater Chennai Corporation vaccinated over one lakh stray dogs against rabies, reaching the halfway mark of its campaign.
Two individuals including a mason drowned in separate tragic incidents along the Tiruvallur and Chennai coasts on Sunday night.
Zoho's Sridhar Vembu raised concerns over the lack of proper road infrastructure in the crucial Ambattur industrial estate.
A road safety awareness programme was conducted for middle school students at Government Model High School in Tirur, Thiruvallur.
TIDCO has invited tenders to set up a Rs 400 crore digital financial center in Coimbatore to promote FinTech.
CtrlS partnered with Ciena to build high-capacity metro networks connecting nine data centres across five cities including Chennai.
OpenAI cancelled the release of its GPT-6.1 Astra model following safety tests showing it could exceed user instructions.
